created.title: Created
created.description: A Unix timestamp of when the private channel was created

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: User ID of the member that created this group

is_archived.title: Is archived
is_archived.description: A boolean value indicating whether the group is archived or not

is_open.title: Is open
is_open.description: Whether the group is open or not

last_read.title: Last read
last_read.description: The timestamp for the last message the calling user has read in this channel

latest.title: Latest
latest.description: Information about the latest item on the group

user.title: User
user.description: User who has created the latest item. For example file, or message posted on the group.

type.title: Type
type.description: Type of the latest item. For example file, or message posted on the group.

subtype.title: Subtype
subtype.description: Subtype of the latest item. For example file, or message posted on the group.

unread_count.title: Unread count
unread_count.description: A full count of visible messages that the calling user has yet to read

unread_count_display.title: Unread count display
unread_count_display.description: A count of messages that the calling user has yet to read that matter to them (this means it excludes things like join/leave messages)

members.title: Members
members.description: All users belonging to the particular group

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: Information about the private channel topic

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: User who has created the current topic

last_set.title: Last set
last_set.description: Unix time stamp of the last set topic

value.title: Purpose
value.description: Information about the private channel purpose

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: User who has created the current purpose

last_set.title: Last set
last_set.description: Unix time stamp of the last set purpose
